meta.source: RERA Karnataka public project records via open dataset github.com/Vonter/karnataka-rera-projects (ODbL 1.0)
meta.selection: Random sample (seed 2026) of 60 of 1992 projects: district=Bengaluru Urban, type=Residential/Group Housing, registration status APPROVED, registered 2018-01-01..2024-12-31

method.original_completion_date: Completion date at registration (proposed_completion_date in the listing)
method.current_completion_date: Current proposed completion date on the project detail page (project_completion_date)
method.extension_months: Whole months from original to current completion date; 0 if not later. Includes COVID-19 general extensions granted by the Authority, which were not project-specific.
method.record_status: 'Completion applied' if the record shows a completion application date; else 'Completion date passed, no completion application in record' if the current completion date is before the dataset snapshot date; else 'Within current completion date'.
method.not_available: Quarterly progress reports are filed as documents and are not included as structured data; construction progress is therefore not shown.
